prompt: Long 135mm lens from the far rail of a low grey rum boat at night, the deck compressed and the sea stacked up behind him. A pale Irish American of about 30 stands three-quarter to us, his face filling a third of the frame: freckles across a narrow nose broken once, red hair under a black fedora, a boxer's split through one eyebrow, clean-shaven, chipped front tooth, shirt open at the throat. He sings mid-word, unbothered. Behind his shoulder, out of focus and huge, a column of water from a warning shot stands lit red and pink. A green running lamp beside him throws clean green light across his cheek and mouth. Wet deck to every edge of the frame, no markings on the boat. Thanks.
